content: दोस् {%m., n.%} [दम्यते अनेन दम् दोऽसि अर्धर्चा˚; <ls>Uṇ. 2. 69</ls>] (दोषन् is optionally substituted for this word after <ab>acc.</ab> dual.) .²1 The forearm, the arm; तमुपाद्रवदुद्यम्य दक्षिणं दोर्निशाचरः <ls>R. 15. 23</ls>; हेमपात्रगतं दोर्भ्यामादधानं पयश्चरुम् <ls n="R.">10. 51</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 76</ls>. .²2 The part of an arc defining its sine. .²3 The side of a triangle or square. .²4 A measure of eighteen inches; <ls>Mātaṅga L. 10. 14</ls>.
